issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS CI: two unconfigured-theme caret-underline XCTests fail on every master run since 8b57693
issue.description:
bob-mac-capture master macOS CI (job "macOS 26 SwiftPM", Test step) has failed on every push since 8b57693, with the same 4 assertion failures in two tests:

- `CapturePanelModelTests.testCaretLeavingUnconfiguredThemeUnderlinesAfterAnalysis` (CapturePanelModelTests.swift:6947/6950, "Condition not met before timeout" then XCTAssertTrue failed)
- `CaptureUnconfiguredThemeHostedTests.testTypingUnconfiguredThemeThenMovingCaretUnderlinesWithoutFreezing` (CaptureUnconfiguredThemeHostedTests.swift:56/59, same pair)

Runs: 40724077224 (8b57693 "stop selection-path repaint freezing on unconfigured themes"), 40728493998 (ebb798a "paint caret underline with the event-time caret", an attempted fix), 40729693701 (e5f6604, bob-cli-dl.7's cancel cue, whose own CaptureRelationCancelTests passed). All three report "Executed N tests, with 4 failures"; Bundle, launch smoke, and install steps are skipped, so master has no green macOS signal.

Found by the bob-cli-dl land agent while confirming bob-cli-dl.7's macOS CI (the bob-cli-dl.7 note #2 follow-up about the unreachable Mac). Not caused by bob-cli-dl: the failures precede e5f6604 and touch only the unconfigured-theme dashed underline from bob-cli-dk.4 / 8b57693. 8b57693 and ebb798a carry no SASE_BEAD trailer, and bob-cli-dk is closed.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical 4 failures (same tests, same lines, timeout then XCTAssertTrue) on three consecutive master runs 40724077224, 40728493998, 40729693701 across three different SHAs; an intervening fix attempt (ebb798a) did not change them.

issue.creation_reason: Master macOS CI has been red for three consecutive pushes with the same four assertion failures, so no Mac change (including bob-cli-dl.7's cancel cue) can show a green run until they are fixed.

payload.description: dr restored the green macOS master signal at 2c3407d; c8c4366's test regression broke it again

payload.entry: Resolved by bob-mac-capture 2c3407d, verified by epic bob-cli-dw phase dw.3. paintHighlighting overwrites the theme range with an explicit empty NSUnderlineStyle and clears the underline color while the caret is in the name. macOS 26 SwiftPM master run 40746228778 (job 123020643000) on 2c3407d: SUCCESS, 3265 tests, 0 failures. Both testCaretLeavingUnconfiguredThemeUnderlinesAfterAnalysis and testTypingUnconfiguredThemeThenMovingCaretUnderlinesWithoutFreezing pass, and Bundle, signature, launch smoke, and install/reinstall all ran and passed. Lander confirmed 2c3407d is an ancestor of master c8c4366 via gh run list. On c8c4366 (run 40750655496) both caret tests still pass. Its single failure is the unrelated CaptureRelationPanelTests refused-cancel badge expectation introduced by c8c4366, now tracked as bob-cli-dz.
